description: Interactive calculators, coin-value tools and historical charts for precious-metals investors — all free, all in your browser.
text:
Tools
14 free calculators, coin-value tools and historical charts — for gold, silver, platinum and
palladium. Live prices update from our spot feed; everything runs in your browser.
Calculators
📈
Return calculator
Model the projected value of a precious-metals purchase over time. All four metals.
💱
Premium calculator
See how much of a dealer's asking price is the metal vs the markup.
💰
Metal value calculator
List your holdings, see the spot-value of each (pure metal × spot × quantity).
⚖️
Weight converter
Troy ounces, grams, kilograms, pennyweight, standard ounces and pounds.
🔁
Gold-to-silver ratio
How many ounces of silver one ounce of gold buys, vs the historical mean.
🧾
Inflation vs gold
Gold's nominal return vs CPI, with the inflation-adjusted real series.
Coin values
🪙
What's my coin worth?
Live melt-value calculator for silver coins and 90% "junk" silver, plus value guides.
🥈
Junk silver value
What 90% silver coins are worth — pre-1965 dimes, quarters and halves, valued live.
🎯
Coin roll counter
How many coins in a roll, total face value, and live silver melt for silver rolls.
Charts & historical data
📊
Price history explorer
LBMA gold/silver/platinum/palladium since 1968, in USD, GBP and EUR.
📅
Price on any date
Look up the LBMA fix on any exact date back to 1968 + "this day in history."
⚖️
Gold/silver ratio history
58 years of the ratio with the mean-reversion percentile lens.
💵
Inflation-adjusted gold
Gold in today's dollars — and the real all-time high.
📉
Gold vs the S&P 500
Long-term performance, both indexed to 100.
